answer: Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the dawn registry records each claim and the nadir audit publishes every slash. A farm must therefore either lie, which the velvet graph proves on replay, or recruit 61 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. That is 36 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
